question: Does current public law and case-specific evidence bind Weiyuan F1 strongly enough to establish post-transfer buyer rent succession and a source-bound first unprepaid receipt window, or does the chain still stop before a commercially promotable 24-month buyer cashflow?

public_sources.title: Weiyuan County Court auction notice replication - Lanhuajie 46 commercial unit
bound_facts: First auction is scheduled for 2026-10-18 to 2026-10-19 at RMB 445,886.28 for the exact 45.08 sqm commercial unit.
The notice states the asset is auctioned with an existing lease from 2022-02-24 through 2029-02-24.
Current rent is RMB 6,000 per month, paid quarterly.
Tenant rent is stated paid through the end of November 2026.
The detailed lease contract is not public and requires case-specific consultation.

public_sources.title: Supreme People's Court reference case Peng v. Zhang enforcement supervision - rent ownership in judicial auction with lease
bound_facts: Reference case library id 2024-17-5-203-007 addresses a judicial auction where the notice disclosed an existing lease but did not separately allocate post-auction rent.
The buyer succeeds the original landlord's lease rights and obligations when ownership transfers.
When the auction notice discloses the lease and does not restrict post-auction rent, the buyer enjoys the rent income right after acquiring ownership.
For a judicial auction, the reference case treats service of the auction-completion adjudication as the ownership-transfer boundary for post-transfer rent.

public_sources.title: Supreme People's Court interpretation of reference case 2024-17-5-203-007
bound_facts: The interpretation states that buyer and tenant need not sign a new lease after judicial auction; the buyer generally assumes the original lease relationship.
It reiterates that the buyer is entitled to rent after the auction-completion adjudication is served.
It does not establish how rent already prepaid to the former owner for a period crossing the ownership-transfer date must be apportioned in this Weiyuan case.

causal_chain: Weiyuan F1 has an exact current entry floor of RMB 445,886.28, an exact RMB 6,000 monthly lease, quarterly cadence, rent paid through 2026-11-30 and lease end 2029-02-24, giving approximately 16.15% surface annual gross before costs.

The Supreme People's Court reference case materially narrows the previous UNKNOWN: when a judicial-auction notice discloses an existing lease and is silent on post-auction rent ownership, the buyer generally succeeds the landlord position and has the rent income right after ownership transfers.
The same authority places the judicial-auction ownership-transfer boundary at service of the auction-completion adjudication on the buyer.

Therefore generic post-transfer rent succession is publicly supported for this transaction shape; the public record no longer needs an invented special clause merely to establish that a buyer can become landlord and collect post-transfer rent.
However the Weiyuan auction is still scheduled for the future, so no actual winning buyer, auction-completion adjudication or service date exists yet in the public record.

The notice proves rent has already been paid through 2026-11-30, but neither the notice nor the reference case binds the treatment of any prepaid rent covering a period after a future ownership-transfer date.

The notice also does not publish the full lease clause that fixes the next quarterly due date, the exact first unprepaid amount/date after 2026-11-30, deposit, arrears, tenant identity or payment ledger.

A December-2026-through-February-2029 tail is long enough on the calendar to contain more than 24 months, but the required buyer-specific 24-month receipt window is not yet source-bound because the actual transfer date and first unprepaid payment node are unresolved.

Exact public searches by execution case (2026)川1024执1832号, judgment (2026)川1024民初929号, exact address and exact rent surfaced no independent lease contract, rent ledger or adjudication for this future auction.

decisive_unknowns_remaining: Whether the scheduled 2026-10-18 auction actually sells and the exact auction-completion adjudication service date.
The exact first unprepaid rent due date and amount after the stated paid-through cursor of 2026-11-30 under the quarterly lease.
Treatment or apportionment of rent already paid to the former owner for any period crossing the future ownership-transfer date.
Tenant identity, payment history, deposit, arrears, utilities/property liabilities, buyer taxes/transfer costs and full lease terms.
